encounter: P12 play_order 137, E0163 TRAINER_ALAN (regular, Mega Aggron), Route110 Trick House puzzle 3, cap 42
availability_audit: Same chronology anchor as play_order 135-136: after Ashen Woods, before Norman, live cap 42, no Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map already walked. Venusaurite's stone window is 14 and Venusaur's base window is 36, both cleared, and the Mega Ring was earned from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources are excluded. No legendary or mythical is used; Kartana is an Ultra Beast, permitted above the cap-24 window, and is a native Petalburg Woods encounter from C05.
plan: Alan is four slow bulky bodies: two Rock/Ground, one Ghost/Ground and a Mega Aggron. Grass is 4x into Rhydon and Golem and 2x into Palossand; Fighting and Ground are 2x into Mega Aggron. The dossier's own Disposition line asks for a special-pressure benchmark against this room, so Alakazam is here for exactly that. Mega Venusaur is the Mega slot for a defensive reason as much as an offensive one: after Thick Fat it resists or is neutral to every single move on Alan's four sets - Rock Slide 1x, Drill Run 0.5x, Body Press 0.5x, Earth Power 0.5x, Stomping Tantrum 0.5x - and Alan carries no Flying, Psychic, Fire or Ice, which are Venusaur's only weaknesses. Water is deliberately absent from the whole party: Palossand's Water Compaction gives it +2 Defense every time a Water move hits it, so the 4x Water hit on the two Rock/Ground bodies is not worth the partner slot it feeds. Kartana's Sacred Sword is the specific answer to that ability and to Aggron's bulk, because it ignores the target's Defense boosts. Amoonguss holds Spore for four battlers that are all slower than it after a Protect turn.
